title: Mud is Fun
lines: Dot sat in the mud. Mud is fun!
A pup sat in the mud.
Mud is on Dot. Mud is on the pup.
Dad sat up. "Not in the mud, Dot!"
"Do it, Dad! It is fun," said Dot.
It is fun to nap in the sun.

questions.ask: Who sat down in the mud at the end?
questions.listenFor: Dad. The story says it plainly. If your child says Dot, point to the line and read it together.

questions.ask: What did Dot say to Dad?
questions.listenFor: Do it, Dad. It is fun. You want the idea that Dot talked Dad into it - that change of mind is the whole story.

questions.ask: Which bit did you like best — Dot in the mud, or Dad in the mud?
questions.listenFor: Either. Ask them to read the line their bit is on, so the pick stays tied to the page.
